question: Which three international organizations jointly organized a trilateral cooperation briefing on February 26, 2025 for Geneva-based health, trade and intellectual property (IP) diplomats?
solution:
The correct answer is __**WHO, WIPO and WTO**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **World Health Organization (WHO):** WHO is a specialized agency of the **United Nations (UN)** responsible for international public health. It plays a critical role in global health initiatives, including combating diseases, promoting healthy lifestyles, and ensuring equitable access to healthcare worldwide.
 
• **World Intellectual Property Organization (WIPO):** WIPO is a global forum for **intellectual property (IP) services, policy, cooperation, and information.** It works to develop a balanced and accessible international IP system, fostering innovation and creativity globally.
 
• **World Trade Organization (WTO):** WTO is an intergovernmental organization that regulates international trade. It ensures smooth trade flows, resolves trade disputes, and facilitates negotiations to ensure fair trading practices globally.
